en.cta_note: You'll log in with HeartBank®, using a passkey: the face or fingerprint you already use to open your phone.
en.desc: A private, encrypted record of your thanks, timestamped to a public ledger. Yours to open and download.
en.disc: HeartBank® is a planetary data bank of gratitude. It is not a chartered bank or financial institution; it does not provide banking services, hold deposits, or extend credit. Nothing is paid here: this service keeps a record of thanks and moves no money. Financial services are not provided by HeartBank.
en.dl_note: The file holds every entry and what you need to check it yourself, even if this service is ever gone. Keep it private: it proves your side.
en.draft_note: This is a draft. No lawyer has reviewed it, and it may change before it is final. Where something is not settled yet, it says so.
en.earth_h1: Every thank makes a crest and a trough.
en.earth_sub: The kind rise and the thankful fall by the same amount, so the sea never gets higher. It only moves.

en.jubilee: On 7 January every balance starts again from zero. These entries stay.

en.leave: When you leave this page, you'll need your passkey to open it again.
en.ledger_json: The same data as a file
en.ledger_sub: Each closed day: every area about 100 km across where at least two sides were counted. No name, no person and no single thank is here.
en.ledger_title_tag: The ledger, day by day · HeartBank®
en.ledger_zero: The zero is how the ledger is built: every thank takes one from the thankful and gives one to the kind. This table shows where the balances sit. It does not prove the zero by itself. For Kiitti, the open sea also holds the side of the things, plants and animals.
en.legend: Kiitos is a thank between two people. Kiitti is care for a thing, a plant or an animal.
en.none_p: This is where your entries will appear. When you thank someone on a HeartBank® app, or someone thanks you, it shows up here.
en.para: When you thank someone on a HeartBank® app, this service keeps an encrypted note that it happened. We timestamp a fingerprint of that note to a public ledger, so it can't be changed later without showing. The note itself stays private and yours: you can open it here and download it. What you wrote, and any amount or time, stays in the app you used. Nothing is paid here.
en.pk_h: This page opens with a passkey
en.pk_p: A passkey is the face or fingerprint you already use to open your phone. It proves the person opening this record is you. Add one to your HeartBank® account, then come back.
en.q_both: Do people who both care and say thanks cross zero more often than people who only care?
en.q_circle: Do people who received before they gave keep giving longer than people who gave first?
en.q_circle_o: Still thanking in the last week
en.q_forward: Of people thanked in a week, how many thanked someone the next week, against those who were not thanked?
en.q_kind: Do people who care for something alive come back more than people who care for a thing?
en.q_single: What did the single person who thanked first this season do next?
en.sample_note: These numbers are made up, to help you imagine what this will look like. The real ledger begins when Season 1 opens on 26 November 2026, and these disappear by themselves.
en.sample_short: Made-up numbers to help you imagine it, until Season 1 opens on 26 November 2026.
en.sch_each: Each group is at least 50 people.
en.sch_refused_p: One of these groups is smaller than 50 people, so nothing comes back: no share, no count, not even how small it was. The code refuses it; no reviewer has to notice.
sch_rules: You write down the question, the hypothesis and the decision rule first, and it is published with a timestamp before it runs.
It is reviewed by a person. Miss Aquarius℠ never chooses which questions are asked.
Only finished seasons are studied, so no answer is about the present.
It runs inside the service, every read logged. Only the comparison leaves.
Every group is at least 50 people, every answer carries noise, and each season has a fixed budget, so many small questions cannot add up to one person.
en.sch_rules_h: How the real door will work
en.scholars_banner: Everything on this page is made up. The people are simulated, and we wrote the patterns into them ourselves, so these results say nothing about real people. It runs the real rules on invented data, to help you imagine the research. The door is not open yet.
en.scholars_sub: A scholar will be able to ask how gratitude moves through people, and get a comparison back: never a row, a pair, a person, a place or a rate.
en.title_home: A private record of your thanks · HeartBank®
en.visits: Visits to this page are counted without cookies.
en.you_sub: Each line is one entry, exactly as it was kept. Each entry shows your side only. Every time this page is opened, the opening is logged, and what it shows is not.
